about: Thermal analysis and calorimetry: load, unload, method (class keys with units), set-temp, temp, wait-temp, gas, start (job-N), stop, result, zero, calibrate, status. power / open / close / estop / ack / wait come from the shared layer. Ranges come from each member's contract (in the unit the argument declares); temperatures are shown in °C.

not_here.mt_mp70: melting point apparatus: primary in property_meter; its temperature programme is that class's method
not_here.malvern_microcalpeaq: ITC: primary in bioassay; titration injections are not a thermal programme
not_here.novocontrol_alphat: temperature-dependent dielectric: primary in electrical (this package)

start: after start the C 6000 waits for the vessel: `chemlab run INST load RFID` scans, hangs and confirms it
start-after: the C 6000 now waits for the vessel: hang it with `chemlab run ika_c6000 load RFID` (the bomb's RFID)
method: method name=... mass=1g creates a measurement record (kind=calibration for a calibration); mode= changes the working mode first
calibrate: calibrate c=8700J/K sets the C value of the vessel (default: the only registered vessel) in the working mode
